description: Golden-corpus ground truth for the NexCODE RAG pipeline. Derived from the real demo corpus by cross-checking two independent production extractors; expectations appear here only when both engines agree. Byte-stable: an unchanged corpus reproduces an identical file.

groundTruthPolicy.pdf: pypdfium2 (production primary) cross-checked against pdf-parse (production fallback)

corpus.notes: No extractable text layer: this document is image-only. Any answer grounded in it can only come from VLM captioning of rendered pages, never from text extraction.
